coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player plugin that integrates Google Tag Manager (GTM) into the Kaltura Player ecosystem, enabling websites to track player events and communicate with GTM servers via the dataLayer API.

featureOwnership: Google Tag Manager script injection (GTM container loading)
Player event tracking (Core, UI, Playlist, Cast events)
High-frequency event filtering (TIME_UPDATE, PROGRESS, FPS_DROP, etc.)

managedStates: Tracked events registry (Set of subscribed events)
Event payload data pushed to dataLayer

repositories.name: kaltura-player-js
repositories.relationship: Core player framework providing BasePlugin, EventManager, and player event system

repositories.name: playkit-js
repositories.relationship: Provides Core event types and FakeEvent interface

repositories.name: playkit-js-ui
repositories.relationship: Provides UI event types for tracking

consumers: End-user web applications embedding Kaltura Player
Google Tag Manager dashboard (receives dataLayer events)
Third-party analytics platforms configured via GTM

externalAPIs.name: Google Tag Manager SDK
externalAPIs.description: GTM JavaScript snippet injection (gtm.js) for tag management

externalAPIs.name: dataLayer API
externalAPIs.description: Google's dataLayer JavaScript array for pushing event data to GTM

entryPoints.description: Plugin registration entry point - registers googleTagManager plugin with Kaltura Player
Core plugin implementation - GoogleTagManager class extending BasePlugin
GTM script templates (HEAD_TAG and BODY_TAG snippets)
